# Provenance Filings API

> Source-linked SEC filing facts for developers and AI agents. Independent of, and not
> affiliated with, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. No market data, no advice.

## Use
- Base URL: this host. All /v1 endpoints need header `X-API-Key`.
- OpenAPI 3.1: /openapi.json . Swagger UI: /docs .
- Errors: {"error": {"code": str, "message": str, "request_id": str}}. 429 carries Retry-After.
- Timestamps ISO 8601 UTC with Z. Dates YYYY-MM-DD. Missing data is null, never 0.

## Endpoints
- GET /v1/companies/search?q={ticker|cik|name}&limit=1..50
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}  (202 + Retry-After while on-demand ingestion runs; 404 if unknown)
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}/filings?limit=1..100&form_type=&since=YYYY-MM-DD&offset=
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}/facts?metric={revenue|operating_income|net_income|total_assets|operating_cash_flow}&period={annual|quarterly|all}&from=&to=&form_type=&include_derived=false&include_all_observations=false
- GET /v1/companies/{cik}/freshness
- POST /v1/watches {"cik","destination_type":"webhook|email","destination"} ; GET /v1/watches ; DELETE /v1/watches/{id} ; GET /v1/watches/{id}/deliveries
- GET /v1/developer/usage?from=&to= ; GET/DELETE /v1/developer/api-keys
- GET /v1/exports/facts?metric=&ciks=a,b&format={csv|json}&limit<=1000

## Interpreting facts
- Every fact has source_url (SEC filing index), source_tag (XBRL concept), accession_number,
  mapping_version, quality_status in {ok, partial, ambiguous_mapping, invalid_source_value, derived}.
- period_class is computed from period dates: annual, quarterly, ytd, other. A ytd value is not a quarter.
- derived=true values are computed by subtraction of two reported year-to-date values; cite them as derived.
- Default facts view returns one observation per period (latest filed); include_all_observations=true shows restatements.
- accepted_at is the SEC acceptance timestamp when available; source_published_at is always null.

## Limits
- Free plan: 60 req/min, 10,000 req/month, 1,000 export rows per request.
- Only the latest ~1,000 filings per company; standard us-gaap tags only; no IFRS or custom extensions.
- Freshness depends on a 5-minute poll interval and SEC propagation; no latency SLA.

## Attribution
Cite values with their source_url. Data: SEC EDGAR (https://www.sec.gov). Review the filing before relying on a value.
